```{r}
library(forecast)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv(r"(C:\Users\nan\OneDrive\Documentos\ucr\practica profesiona\dengue-recurrent-cr\full_data.csv)")
```

```{r}
canton = "-101"
```

```{r}
df_canton <- df |> filter(grepl(canton, week_canton))

ts_regular <- ts(df_canton$rr, frequency = 52)

ts_log <- ts(log(df_canton$rr + 0.2), frequency = 52)

train_data <- ts_log[1:252]

test_data <- ts_regular[253:304]
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
model0 <- auto.arima(
    train_data,
    seasonal = TRUE,
    stepwise = FALSE,
    approximation = FALSE, ic = "aic"
)

y_pred <- forecast(model0, h = 52)
y_pred_real <- y_pred$mean
```

```{r}
model2 <- Arima(
    train_data,
    order = c(0,1,3),
    seasonal = list(order = c(0,0,1), period = 52)
)
summary(model2)
```

```{r}
plot(y_pred)
```


```{r}
metricas <- accuracy(test_data, y_pred_real) / mean(test_data)
```

metricas[2]
